title: On the Malliavin calculus on product spaces and an infinite de Jong theorem
summary: We extend the Malliavin theory for $L^2$-functionals on product probability spaces that has recently been developed independently by Decreusefond and Halconruy (2019) and by Duerinckx (2021), by characterizing the domains and investigating the actions of the three Malliavin operators in terms of the infinite Hoeffding decomposition in $L^2$, which we identify as the natural analogue of the famous Wiener-Itô chaos decomposition on Gaussian and Poisson spaces.
